source.geometry: OSM public walking ways; every rendered point is an OSM node

networkSelection.seed: Exact node-pair plus way edges used by the five mapped routes, six peak snaps, and complete named mountain ways; route ways are never seeded wholesale.
networkSelection.roadLinks: Only exact road-link edges used by the five mapped routes are retained, as geometry and barriers.
networkSelection.expansionBarrier: Every non-walking highway is a barrier; ordinary pedestrian/cycleway edges expand only when they are exact route edges or named mountain ways.
networkSelection.missingConnections: No synthetic straight-line connectors; unshared OSM nodes and filtered links remain disconnected.

source.note: Road links are kept only where the five mapped routes use them; no straight-line connectors are generated.
